purpose: Make repository context reconstruction deterministic without falsely promoting every historical artifact into current scientific authority.
binding_rule: After closure, every high-signal artifact must be explicitly indexed, recoverable through FIT1 descendant commit lineage, or explicitly accepted as historical provenance already present at the FIT1 gate. Any UNEXPLAINED artifact is a fail-closed continuity regression.
closure_semantics: Context/provenance coverage only. AOA closure does not retroactively validate every historical report, promote branch code, convert implementation into execution, prove FIT1/generalization, refreeze Geppetto, or authorize Arachne training.

closure_requirements.requirement: FIT1-to-now exact commit/change chronology is mechanically recoverable across live refs.
Pre-FIT residuals have an explicit non-authoritative provenance disposition rather than being falsely declared reviewed/current.
Current IRIS, Geppetto, Arachne and deterministic surrounding responsibilities are first-class continuation context.
Known scientific corrections are preserved, including IRIS quarantine, C2 implemented-vs-run correction and AR-01 terminal verdict.
Post-closure new unexplained high-signal artifacts fail closed.
Rehydration supports the scientifically valid state of zero active experiments.

postclosure_rules: Exact scientific claims still require exact prereg/result/source authority; commit subjects are discovery aids only.
Branch existence and recency never imply authority; unregistered non-main branches are evidence-only by safe default.
AOA closure does not authorize automatic deletion of evidence branches.
Continuity CI must keep generated FIT1 lineage, coverage, authority map and rehydration packet current on the user's local self-hosted runner.
